notes.title: SCAN, SOLVE, SURVIVE Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Story: There are now many bizarre objects scattered across the world. Together they hint at how to escape, if you can piece it all together
[*] Scanning: Interact with these objects by using your scanner. Scanned Objects are added to the clues screen where you can piece together their meaning
[*] Entity Compendium: Scan enemies to learn more about their quirks, and how to avoid them
[*] Bonus Tasks: Each round you’re given 3 random tasks that you can choose to complete for extra rewards
[/list]

[b]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Single Player now has a prompt to Save Game after a round
[*] Single Player save data doesn’t delete itself when failing
[*] Emotes are now in a Radial Menu (Press TAB to display/hide)
[*] Improved platforming
[*] Dismiss controls on UI while in Menus
[*] ADVANCE button is now NEXT
[*] Flare gun now properly kills players
[*] Cursors on screens are now synced in multiplayer
[*] Load Level Selection has a header during the intro
[*] Wall Monsters now have an idle audio
[*] Room Code font changed to be more readable
[*] Fixed issues where abducted players were not appearing properly on the minimap
[*] Fixed an issue where if a player had an item equipped when the level was unloaded, that item would sometimes be invisible in their hands when a new level is loaded
[/list]

- Fixed late game save issues
- Pellets to repel was overlapping at higher quotas

- Tactical arrows are now placed higher than sidewalks
- Removed collision on hedges everywhere
- Item names updated on storefronts and level select
- Crying Black Hole teleports anyone who touches it, not just the target

- Teleporter now says PRESS instead of NONE
- Virus propagation time increased
- Virus performance improved
- Fixed Toast windows explaining certain mechanics not appearing
- Store now says FREE for items that cost 0
- Added dialog box with avatar

notes.title: V0.8.07
notes.content:
A bunch of fixes have been added!

[list]
[*] Added Raytracing setting to options menu.
[*] Fixed issues with gamepad and minimap upgrade buttons.
[*] fixed issue where users dying while using flashlight would have it burn through pellets after death.
[*] Fixed issue where "virus goop" was not showing up properly on the minimap.
[*] Fixed z fighting on Front End neon sign 
[*] Fixed issue where Ms Croak-Man would sometime hold "invisible agro" and sprint around the map.
[*] Fixed issue where holodiscs could break if you start a match, quit out, change your characters, and restart.
[*] Fixed an issue where clients quitting and then re-joining matches could cause a broken state, in some cases.
[*] Fixed spectator camera not respecting input controls and having low joystick sensitivity.
[*] Fixed issue where accepting a steam invite while in the game's intro put the game into a broken state.
[/list]
